summary: Independent probe 2026-11-20 (~17:37-17:59 UTC). Two live HTTP calls total, within the pre-set 1-2 free-call budget; no paid call. (1) Demo endpoint with docs ASIN B09DJLW458 -> HTTP 200 from a shared sample copy: free_calls_remaining stayed 3, free_call_used=false, x-price-next-call $0.003, 38757 bytes, request_id 65347b57-f378-4af9-be43-ed5b109c6848 — the canonical docs ASIN never touches the payment path. (2) Live call with own ASIN B08N5WRWNW -> HTTP 404 'ASIN not found on this marketplace domain', 1.73 s, 174 bytes, request_id b675d905-2c2d-47ff-ae71-739204a3a4ba, X-Free-Probes-Remaining 3->2: a miss is 'billed' for keyless clients exactly as llms-full.txt states. (3) Documented payment path (llms.txt / llms-full.txt / .well-known/x402 / dash.apiguru.app/openapi.json): 3 free calls per client per 24h, then 402 with PAYMENT-REQUIRED header (base64 accepts, scheme exact), client signs EIP-3009 authorization and retries with PAYMENT-SIGNATURE; gateway settles on-chain only after a billable answer; X-Payment-Status: not-settled and no charge when the failure is theirs; no gas needed (facilitator submits the transfer); one call costs at most $0.05; gateway answers 504 deadline_exceeded itself after 55 s (not billed). Facilitator identity NOT named anywhere (0 matches in openapi.json). (4) Price discrepancy: README says 'about a cent a call', actual documented/live price $0.003 per /v2/product-details call. (5) Paid call NOT executed: sandbox has no funded Base wallet (needs ~$0.003 USDC; gas not needed) — settle timing and PAYMENT-RESPONSE tx hash therefore not observed; the live 402 challenge body (real accepts with per-network assets) also not observed since free probes were not exhausted on purpose. Verdict: suitable as a demo target only AFTER one funded call by the operator; key path and spend controls are ready.
